properties.displayName: QC - D - Known bad URLs OneNote
properties.description:
This query searches for known bad URLs that are associated with previously reported OneNote Malware.
Any results found during this queries execution should be reviewed deeper to determine if connections were successful
or blocked and if any files were dropped from these connections. Please verify connection status using available firewall logs, etc.
references:
- https://www.proofpoint.com/us/blog/threat-insight/onenote-documents-increasingly-used-to-deliver-malware
